svg.text: Which squares the first 80 blocks make: numbered across first, or in groups of 8 rows
The qkv forward's first 12 rows of squares (of 32). The number in a square is its block's number; purple: blocks 0–79, which run together.
bands of x read: 5 (blue) bands of W: 18 (orange)
5 + 18 = 23 bands of 128 rows from GPU memory
(b) in groups of 8 rows, down first: now
bands of x read: 8 (blue) bands of W: 10 (orange)
8 + 10 = 18 bands of 128 rows from GPU memory
For the head, 393 columns of squares, the difference is large: across first, the 80 blocks share 1 band of x
but need 80 bands of W: 81. In groups, 8 + 10 = 18. W is 154 MB and the T4's L2 cache is 4 MB, so every band
read once more is read from GPU memory. That was run 10: the head's forward got 15% faster.
